sections.h2: Pleasant Grove Home Prices and Market Pace
sections.html:
In the 24 months from November 15, 2024 to November 14, 2026, 85 residential sales closed in Pleasant Grove (Chesapeake, VA) according to REIN MLS records. The median sold price was $628,000, above the citywide median of $420,000, and homes took a median of 26 days to sell, slower than the citywide median of 18 days. These figures come from closed sales, which show what homes actually sold for rather than asking prices.

The middle half of Pleasant Grove sales closed between $425,000 and $765,000, or about $258 per square foot against $219 citywide. Split by year, the median sold price in the most recent 12 months ($551,450, 50 sales) was about 18% lower than in the earlier 12 months ($674,900, 35 sales). The typical home sold right at its list price (median sale-to-list ratio of 100%).

sections.h2: What Kinds of Homes Sell in Pleasant Grove
sections.html:
98% of the sales were detached homes and 2% were attached homes (townhomes or condos). The median home was about 2,416 square feet, with the middle half of sales running from roughly 1,600 to 3,100 square feet. 48% of the homes that sold had 4 bedrooms.

Home ages vary widely here: about 80% of sales were built between 1957 and 2021, with a median year built of 1992.

Averages hide a lot, so Chris Jenkins compares you to homes that match yours on street, size, age and condition rather than to the whole Pleasant Grove median.
